# ScriptTaskHandle

[API index](../index.md)

Retained view and control handle for one named script task definition.

The observed fields remain readable after disposal. Mutations require the original live runtime
endpoint and are rejected by the host when this handle is stale or foreign.

**@keywords**

task, handle, state, cancellation, scheduling

## PhaseName

```typescript
readonly PhaseName: string;
```

Current named checkpoint phase, or an empty string before the first checkpoint.
The name survives suspension, termination, and disposal until rearm or admission.

**@keywords**
